Rashi on Yevamot 28b:10:1.hebrew: בכולן אני קורא בהן - בכל חמש עשרה עריות דבפ"ק, אפשר להן להיות שתי אחיות נופלות לשני אחין: והאחת אסורה על זה משום אחת מכל העריות הללו ומותרת לזה, והשניה אסורה על זה משום אותו שם ערוה עצמו ומותרת לזה; ומתוך כך נמצאו שתי אחיות מתייבמות, ולא פגעו באחות זקוקה. וכולן פירשתי בפ"א (דף ט:):
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:10:1.english: With regard to all of them I apply [this] to them - In all fifteen [categories of] forbidden relatives [listed] in the first chapter, it is possible for them to be two sisters who fall [for levirate marriage] to two brothers: one [sister] is forbidden to one [brother] due to one of all these forbidden relationships and is permitted to the other, and the second [sister] is forbidden to the other [brother] due to that very same category of forbidden relationship and is permitted to the first. As a result, two sisters end up entering into levirate marriage without encountering [the prohibition of] the sister of a woman bound [by the levirate bond]. And I have explained all of them in the first chapter (9b).

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:12:1.hebrew: באונסין - בבתו מאנוסתו. כגון: ראובן אנס אשה והוליד בת, ובא שמעון ואנס אנוסת אחיו והוליד בת, ונישאו בת ראובן ובת שמעון ללוי ויהודה אחי אביהן, והרי הן אחיות מן האם; בת שמעון מותרת לראובן, ובת ראובן מותרת לשמעון, ונמצאו שתי אחיות מתייבמות. וכן בת בתו, וכן כולן. אע"ג דכל חמשה בבי דרישא משתכחי בנשואין, הואיל ובתו לא משתכחא שיהו שתי בנות של שני אחין אחיות מן האם — שאי אפשר שנשא יבמתו שיש לה בת — לא תני בהו "האסורה לזה כו'", הואיל וכולן איסור שם בת הן:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:12:1.english: Through rape - [This refers] to his daughter from a woman he raped. For example: Reuven raped a woman and fathered a daughter, and Shimon came and raped the woman his brother had raped and fathered a daughter, and Reuven's daughter and Shimon's daughter married Levi and Yehudah, their fathers' brothers — and behold, they are sisters from the [same] mother; [when Levi and Yehudah die,] Shimon's daughter is permitted to Reuven, and Reuven's daughter is permitted to Shimon, and thus two sisters are found to be taken in levirate marriage. And similarly his daughter's daughter, and similarly all of them. Even though all five cases of the first clause can be found through marriage, since [the case of] his daughter cannot be found where two daughters of two brothers are sisters from the [same] mother — for it is impossible that he married his yevamah who has a daughter — [the Mishnah] does not teach regarding them "the one who is forbidden to this one, etc.," since all of them are [under] the prohibition of the category of daughter.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:14:1.hebrew: דאליבא דרבי שמעון היא דמשכחת בה - האסורה לזה, כדמפרש רב ספרא לקמיה:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:14:1.english: That it is according to Rabbi Shimon that you find in it - [the case of] the woman who is forbidden to this [brother], as Rav Safra explains below.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:14:2.english: [He] does not deal with [a case of] dispute - Rabbi Ḥiyya.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:17:1.hebrew: האסורה לזה - אשת לוי האסורה ליששכר, שבא ומצאה אסורה עליו מזיקת ראובן שלא היה בעולמו, ומותרת לזבולן, שכשנולד כבר נתייבמה ללוי, ובייבם ולבסוף נולד שרי ר"ש. ואשת יהודה אסורה לזבולון משום שמעון שלא היה בעולמו, וכשנולד מצאה באיסור, ומותרת ליששכר:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:17:1.english: She who is forbidden to this one - Levi's wife, who is forbidden to Yissakhar, because he came [into the world] and found her forbidden to him due to the levirate bond of Reuven, who was not alive in his lifetime; and she is permitted to Zevulun, because when he was born she had already been taken in levirate marriage by Levi, and in [a case where a brother] performed levirate marriage and afterward [the younger brother] was born, Rabbi Shimon permits [her]. And Yehudah's wife is forbidden to Zevulun on account of Shimon, who was not alive in his lifetime, and when he was born he found her in a state of prohibition; and she is permitted to Yissakhar.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:18:1.hebrew: בלא ייבם יהודה נמי - שרי ליששכר, ובחמשה אחי משכחת לה. מת ראובן, נולד יששכר, ייבם לוי, מת שמעון, נולד זבולון, ומת לוי בלא בנים, ונפלו אשת לוי ואשת שמעון לפני יששכר וזבולון. אשת לוי אסורה ליששכר מפני ראובן בעלה הראשון, ומותרת לזבולון; ואשת שמעון מותרת ליששכר, שהרי בעולמו היה, ואסורה לזבולון:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:18:1.english: Even without Yehuda performing levirate marriage - [she] is permitted to Yissakhar, and you find it with five brothers: Reuven died, Yissakhar was born, Levi performed levirate marriage [with Reuven's wife], Shimon died, Zevulun was born, and Levi died without children, and Levi's wife and Shimon's wife fell [for levirate marriage] before Yissakhar and Zevulun. Levi's wife is forbidden to Yissakhar because of Reuven, her first husband, and permitted to Zevulun; and Shimon's wife is permitted to Yissakhar, since [Yissakhar] was [alive] in his [Shimon's] lifetime, and forbidden to Zevulun.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:19:1.hebrew: ומשום צרה - האי דנקט ייבם יהודה, משום צרה, דבעי אשכוחי נמי בצרה האסורה לזה מותרת לזה: אם באו יששכר וזבולון לייבם לנשי לוי ויהודה, הראשונה אשת לוי אסורה ליששכר משום צרת אשת אחיו שלא היה בעולמו, וכן אשת יהודה על זבולון, וכגון שהיו הצרות אחיות זו לזו — ונכריות קרי להו אצל נשי ראובן ושמעון — דאיכא נמי השתא בצרות האסורה לזה מותרת לזה, ואחותה כשהיא יבמתה כו'. ואי לא ייבם יהודה, לא מיתוקם מילתא דרבי חייא באיסור צרה, דאם נפלו שתי נשים משמעון, שתיהן אשת אח שלא היה בעולמו הן:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:19:1.english: And due to [a] rival wife - That [the Mishnah] stated "Yehudah performed yibbum" [is] because of [the case of] a rival wife, for it wants to find also with respect to a rival wife [the principle of] "the one forbidden to this one is permitted to that one": if Yissachar and Zevulun come to perform yibbum with the wives of Levi and Yehudah, the first [one], the wife of Levi, is forbidden to Yissachar because of [being] the rival wife of the wife of his brother who was not in his world, and similarly the wife of Yehudah [is forbidden] to Zevulun — and [this is] in a case where the rival wives were sisters to each other, and [the Mishnah] calls them "strangers" in relation to the wives of Reuven and Shimon — so that now there is also among the rival wives [the rule of] "the one forbidden to this one is permitted to that one, and her sister, when she is her yevamah, etc." And if Yehudah had not performed yibbum, the statement of Rabbi Chiyya would not be established regarding the prohibition of a rival wife, for if two wives fell [for yibbum] from Shimon, both of them are [already] "the wife of a brother who was not in his world."

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:19:2.hebrew: צרה דצרה מאי איכא למימר - היכי קרית "האסורה לזה מותרת לזה" באיסור וצרות צרה? דהא צרות צרותיהן נמי תנן בפ"ק:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:19:2.english: What can be said [about] the rival wife of a rival wife? - How can you apply "[the one who is] forbidden to this one is permitted to that one" to the prohibition [of a rival wife] and the rival wives of a rival wife? For indeed, we also learned [about] "the rival wives of their rival wives" in the first chapter [of this tractate].

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:1:1.hebrew: איסור מצוה - אם היתה האחת אסורה על האחד איסור מצוה, אינו מותר באחותה; הואיל והיא מדאורייתא רמיא קמיה, הואי אידך אחות זקוקתו. הלכך, בעו חליצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:1:1.english: A prohibition [due to] a mitzva - If one [of the sisters] was forbidden to one [of the brothers] by a prohibition [due to] a mitzva, he is not permitted [to marry] her sister; since by Torah law she falls before him [for levirate marriage], the other [sister] is the sister of his zekukah [the woman bound to him for levirate marriage]. Therefore, they require ḥalitza.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:1:3.hebrew: איסור מצוה לחודה - לא אשמעינן אלא יבמה שנפלה לפניו, שהיא אסורה עליו איסור מצוה, חולצת:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:1:3.english: A prohibition due to a mitzvah alone - It only taught us [regarding] a yevamah who fell before him, who is forbidden to him [by] a prohibition due to a mitzvah, [that] she performs chalitzah.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:1:4.hebrew: והכא אשמועינן איסור מצוה ואחותה - שנפלו לו משני אחין, דאחותה לא מייבמא, דלא תימא אוקי איסור מצוה במקום ערוה, ותתייבם אחותה ולא תיהוי כאחות זקוקתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:1:4.english: And here [the Mishnah] teaches us [a case of] a prohibition due to a mitzva and her sister - Where they fell before him [for levirate marriage] from two brothers, [teaching] that her sister may not enter into levirate marriage; so that you should not say, "Place a prohibition due to a mitzva in the place of a forbidden relative," and [thus] her sister may enter into levirate marriage and not be considered like the sister of a woman bound to him [by the levirate bond].

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:20:1.hebrew: כגון דהדר יבמינהו גד ואשר - לנשי לוי ויהודה הראשונות, ולהם נשים, וייבם גד את אשת יהודה, ואשר ייבם אשת לוי, ומתו גד ואשר, ונפלו לפני יששכר וזבולון. ואם באים לייבם נשי גד ואשר הראשונות: אשת גד — צרת אשת יהודה, שהיתה צרת אשת שמעון שלא היה בעולמו — אסורה לזבולון ומותרת ליששכר, וכן אשת אשר אסורה על יששכר ומותרת לזבולון:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:20:1.english: Where Gad and Asher subsequently performed levirate marriage with them - [That is,] with the first wives of Levi and Judah, while they [themselves already] had wives; and Gad performed levirate marriage with the wife of Judah, and Asher performed levirate marriage with the wife of Levi. Then Gad and Asher died, and [their wives] fell [for levirate marriage] before Issachar and Zebulun. And if they come to perform levirate marriage with the first wives of Gad and Asher: the wife of Gad — [who is] the rival wife of the wife of Judah, who was the rival wife of the wife of Simeon, who was not in his world [i.e., Zebulun was not yet born in Simeon's lifetime] — is forbidden to Zebulun and permitted to Issachar; and similarly, the wife of Asher [is forbidden] to Issachar and permitted to Zebulun.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:23:1.english: At the time that they become rival wives to each other - For example, now, when they fell before him [for levirate marriage] and two sisters became rival wives to each other through the levirate bond.

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:25:1.hebrew: ליגזור משום שתי אחיות דעלמא - אע"ג דהא נמי מרישא שמעינן, התם הוא לרבנן לא גזרינן, דאי נמי אתי למישרי אחיות דעלמא, ליכא אלא איסור אחות זקוקה דרבנן; אבל לר"ש, דאמר איסור אחות זקוקה ערוה גמורה היא, דרחמנא פטרה וקיימא עליה באיסור אשת אח, ליגזור היכא דאחותה אסורה משום ערוה ולא זקוקה ליה, ונימא לא לייבם לאחותה דלא ליתי לייבומי אחות זקוקה דעלמא. קמ"ל:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:25:1.english: We should issue a decree due to two sisters in general - Although we learn this from the first clause [of the Mishnah] as well, there it is according to the Rabbis [that] we do not issue a decree, for even if one comes to permit [two] sisters in general, there is only the rabbinic prohibition of the sister of a woman bound by levirate ties (zekukah). However, according to Rabbi Shimon, who says [that] the prohibition of the sister of a zekukah is a full-fledged forbidden relative (ervah) — for the Merciful One exempted her, and she remains under the prohibition of a brother's wife — we should issue a decree where her sister is forbidden as a forbidden relative and is not bound to him, and say [that] he should not perform levirate marriage with her sister, so that he will not come to perform levirate marriage with the sister of a zekukah in general. [Therefore,] it teaches us [otherwise].

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:3:1.hebrew: משום מצוה עבוד רבנן - שתתקיים מצות יבום, ולא העמידו איסור זיקה — שהוא מדבריהם — לאסור את אחותה היכא דהיא עליו איסור מצוה, קמ"ל:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:3:1.english: Due to the mitzvah, the Sages did [so] - [Meaning,] so that the mitzvah of levirate marriage would be fulfilled, and they did not uphold the prohibition of zikah [the levirate bond] — which is rabbinic — to forbid her sister where she is [only] a prohibition of a mitzvah to him; [therefore,] it teaches us [that they did not].

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:5:1.hebrew: הכא ליכא שני דמוכח - שהרי שתיהן מתייבמות, ואתי למישרי אחות זקוקה בעלמא, ואימא לא לייבמן, קמ"ל:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:5:1.english: Here there is no second [brother] who indicates - For both of them are taken in levirate marriage, and [people] might come to permit the sister of a woman bound by a levirate bond in general, and [thus] I would say they should not be taken in levirate marriage; [therefore, it] teaches us [that they may].

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:6:1.hebrew: תרוייהו מוכחי אהדדי - שזה לא יכול לישא את האחרת אלא זו, וכן זו — מוכחא מילתא שזו אסורה על זה וזו על זה; לפיכך ליכא אחות זקוקתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:6:1.english: They both indicate [the status of] each other - For this [brother] cannot marry the other [woman], only this one, and similarly [with] this [other] one — the matter is evident that this [woman] is forbidden to this [brother] and that [woman] to that [brother]; therefore, there is no [case of] the sister of his zekukah [levirate-bound woman].

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:8:1.hebrew: היינו הך - דהא בהדיא קתני לה לעיל, איסור מצוה ואיסור קדושה חולצת:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:8:1.english: This is [identical to] that - For it explicitly teaches it above: "[If she is subject to] a prohibition [resulting from] a mitzva or a prohibition [resulting from] sanctity, she performs chalitzah."

Rashi on Yevamot 28b:9:1.hebrew: כי לא אמרינן אוקי איסור מצוה במקום ערוה - להתייבם אחותה, היכא דאין איסור מצוה אלא באחת על האחד, ולשני שתיהן זקוקות, דאי שרית לייבומי להאי שהאחת אסורה עליו, אתי שני נמי לייבומי וקא פגע באחות זקוקתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 28b:9:1.english: When we do not say: Place a prohibition [resulting from] a mitzvah in the place of a forbidden relative - [so as] to allow her sister to enter levirate marriage, [that is] where the prohibition [resulting from] a mitzvah applies only to one [sister] for the one [brother], while for the second [brother] both of them are bound [in levirate attachment]; for if you permit this [brother], to whom the one [sister] is forbidden, to perform levirate marriage, the second [brother] will also come to perform levirate marriage, and he will encounter [the prohibition of] the sister of his zekukah [a woman bound to him by levirate attachment].

Tosafot on Yevamot 28b:23:1.hebrew: שנעשו צרות זו לזו כו' - היינו דוקא כשנפלו לפני יבם אחד, אבל כשנפלו לפני שני יבמין מודה רבי שמעון, כדתניא לעיל: "רבי שמעון אומר יקיימו":
Tosafot on Yevamot 28b:23:1.english: "[At the time] that they became rival wives to each other," etc. - This is specifically when they fell before one yavam, but when they fell before two yevamim, Rabbi Shimon concedes, as it was taught [in a baraita] above: "Rabbi Shimon says: They may keep [them]."

Tosafot on Yevamot 28b:5:1.hebrew: אבל הכא דליכא שני דמוכח - ואם תאמר: הא נמי ידעינן מההיא דפ"ב, כדאמרינן לעיל (יבמות דף כ.)? ויש לומר: דהתם איכא ערוה דקמוכח, שאינה לא חולצת ולא מתייבמת; אבל הכא — שתיהן מתייבמות, וליכא הוכחה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 28b:5:1.english: However, here, where there is not a second [brother] who indicates [this] - And if you will say: Do we not also know this from that [case] in the second chapter, as we said above (Yevamot 20a)? One can answer that there, there is a forbidden relative [ervah] who indicates [the prohibition], as she neither performs chalitzah nor enters into levirate marriage; however, here, both of them enter into levirate marriage, and there is no indication.
